_comment: Facts about THIS project. evalconfig.py explains why each is here rather than in a script.
_agents: The trace is the source of truth; these only cover an export that missed one.
_write_tools: cw_patch was in the old hard-coded set and does not exist. Eight tools that plainly mutate were missing from it. Prefixes cover the family so a new cw_set_* or cw_update_* is a write the day it appears.
_toolbox_env: What the hosted agents' code reads to find their toolbox, per --inspect-code.
_local_tools: Foundry-side tools a hosted agent runs itself (skills, tool search). A recording that happens not to call one must not make a replay that does look like a stub bypass.
_replay_tool_label: Fallback only. A replay binds under the server_label its recording used (ConnectWise-PSA-ForAgents___*), read from the cassette, because the label is part of every tool name the agent sees.
